versions.changelog: Unique redeployer name to avoid collision; handle already-stopped stack; move imports to top; cleanup stale containers on name prefix
Remove hardcoded Portainer URL; require from PORTAINER_URL env
Rewrite redeploy flow for Portainer 2.41 compat: stop→PUT with preserved env→async deploy. Remove legacy --mode redeploy. Add --stack and --no-pull to --mode update.
Add --mode redeploy for non-Claw stacks via native Portainer API; add --stack and --no-pull args
Auto-load PORTAINER_API_KEY from workspace .env.portainer; safer token management
Remove hardcoded API key from manage.py; require PORTAINER_API_KEY env var instead
v4: one-shot redeployer container instead of persistent helper. 0 resource consumption, creates temp alpine container on-demand for stop→start cycle, exits immediately after.
v3: safe webhook-based redeploy, no Docker socket dependency, all operations via Portainer API
Initial release - manage OpenClaw stack via Portainer API
